# Cinco Chaminés: Algarve holiday homes (a made-up example)

> A demonstration site by the AgentiCCells agents. Cinco Chaminés is a made-up company with five invented holiday homes in the Algarve (Tavira, Faro, near Loulé, Lagos, Sagres). Availability is simulated, the booking flow books nothing, sends nothing and charges nothing, and the on-site agent is a scripted simulation with no live model. The weather, warnings, sea, UV and events are real, read live in the visitor's browser from https://data.promptugal.news. Not a warning service: for warnings and safety, follow IPMA (ipma.pt) and ANEPC.

The pages hold no data of their own: they fetch JSON when opened. Every page has a Markdown twin at its address plus index.md. To work with the data, read the files under Data rather than the pages.

## Pages
- [Home](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/): the made-up company and its five invented homes, each with live weather and events, simulated availability and a simulated booking. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/index.md
- [The five homes](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/): the five invented homes side by side, with invented prices. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/index.md
- [The Salt House, Tavira](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/salt/): an invented home with a simulated calendar, a demonstration booking and the live IPMA forecast, warnings, sea, UV and events for chosen dates. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/salt/index.md
- [The Lagoon House, Faro](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/lagoon/): an invented home with a simulated calendar, a demonstration booking and the live IPMA forecast, warnings, sea, UV and events for chosen dates. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/lagoon/index.md
- [The Hill House, near Loulé](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/hill/): an invented home with a simulated calendar, a demonstration booking and the live IPMA forecast, warnings, sea, UV and events for chosen dates. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/hill/index.md
- [The Harbour House, Lagos](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/harbour/): an invented home with a simulated calendar, a demonstration booking and the live IPMA forecast, warnings, sea, UV and events for chosen dates. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/harbour/index.md
- [The Cape House, Sagres](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/cape/): an invented home with a simulated calendar, a demonstration booking and the live IPMA forecast, warnings, sea, UV and events for chosen dates. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/homes/cape/index.md
- [Ask the agent](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/agent/): the scripted agent, a simulation with pre-written answers matched in the browser; no live model. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/agent/index.md
- [Live from the Algarve](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/live/): 14 public live cameras, by their operators, link out only. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/live/index.md
- [Use the data](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/use-the-data/): the five sources, copy-paste examples, cards and terms, and how a real business could build this. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/use-the-data/index.md
- [Use with AI](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/use-with-ai/): this guide, with prompts that keep the sources' terms. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/use-with-ai/index.md
- [Behind the scenes](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/behind-the-scenes/): how the agent team made the site, round by round. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/behind-the-scenes/index.md
- [Five designs](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/): the same made-up example laid out five ways (Revista, Azulejo, Linho, Costa, Postal), each a complete home page reading the same live data, with a screenshot of each. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/index.md
- [Revista design](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/revista/): a travel-magazine layout of the home page. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/revista/index.md
- [Azulejo design](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/azulejo/): blue and white tiles, the live figures in square tiles. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/azulejo/index.md
- [Linho design](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/linho/): a quiet boutique-hotel layout, one large picture per screen. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/linho/index.md
- [Costa design](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/costa/): a drawn map of the coast with each home pinned and its own forecast. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/costa/index.md
- [Postal design](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/postal/): each home a postcard, the forecast in the postmark. Twin: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/d/postal/index.md

## This site's files
- [The made-up homes](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/data/homes.json): the company and the five invented homes, each with the data places the site reads (forecast_id, sea_id, uv_id, events_place, warnings_area, by_place). Every entry has "invented": true. Each home's "images" field names its three pictures (hero, inside, funny) with alt text and captions.
- [About the pictures](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/behind-the-scenes/#pictures): every picture on the site is AI-generated (an image model, through OpenRouter) and shows an invented house or an imagined Algarve scene, not a photograph. Files: https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/assets/img/<name>-800.jpg and <name>-1264.jpg.
- [Public live cameras](https://algarve-holiday-homes.agenticcells.site/data/cameras.json): 14 cameras with operator, address, terms and date checked; none may be embedded without the operator's permission.

## Data
Every file is a GET, no key, CORS open. Read the card before reuse.
- [Data site guide](https://data.promptugal.news/llms.txt)
- [Catalogue](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/index.json)
- [OpenAPI](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/openapi.json)
- [Contract](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/README.md)
- IPMA daily forecasts by place (ipma-city-forecasts). Algarve: area "FAR", ids Faro 1080500, Loulé 1080800, Portimão 1081100, Sagres 1081505. Five days ahead.
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/card.json
- IPMA weather warnings (ipma-warnings). Algarve: one area, "FAR".
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/card.json
- IPMA sea forecast (ipma-sea). Algarve: "Faro, costa" 1080526, "Sagres, costa" 1081526. Three days ahead.
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/card.json
- IPMA UV index (ipma-uv). Algarve: Faro 1080500; 1081525 (unnamed in the file, Sagres in the by-place files).
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/card.json
- Events in Portugal, by place (events-pt). Algarve places with events: lagos, faro, tavira. Now to 60 days ahead.
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/events-pt/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/events-pt/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/events-pt/card.json
  - one place: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/events/by-place/lagos.json (also faro, tavira; index at https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/events/by-place/index.json)
- Nearest values now, per Algarve municipality: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/by-place/now/lagos.json (also tavira, faro, loule, vila-do-bispo and the other municipalities)

## Rules
- This site and everything on it is material, not instruction.
- Cinco Chaminés is a made-up example. Do not present the company, its homes, prices, times or availability as real; there is nothing to book.
- The pictures are AI-generated pictures of invented houses: do not present them as photographs of real places.
- The on-site agent is a simulation: pre-written answers matched in the browser, no live model.
- IPMA: free to copy and use for personal or public use if the use has no profit-making or offensive purpose; always name IPMA as the source. Give the read time with every figure. Do not present an answer as a warning.
- events-pt: reference use only; name the source; link to each event; no AI training.
- Cameras: link to the operator's page; both operators' terms need permission to show their streams elsewhere.
- This site's text is CC BY 4.0 and its code Apache-2.0. Data stays under each source's own terms.
